# The Most Useful Site in the World

> 1119 free, self-contained browser tools — calculators, converters,
> generators and simulators across 27 categories. Every tool
> runs 100% client-side: no accounts, no keys, zero third-party scripts.
> Made for humans, and deliberately easy for AI agents to navigate.

## How to use this site as an AI agent

- [Machine manifest (JSON)](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/cards/cards.json): one object per tool — fields: name, title, description, category, file, path.
- [Concise index (this file)](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/llms.txt) and [full catalogue](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/llms-full.txt): every tool listed.
- [Static directory (zero-JS HTML)](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools-index.html): all tools as plain links.
- [Programmatic-use guide](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/ai.html): URL patterns, embedding, worked example. Markdown: [ai.html.md](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/ai.html.md).
- [Run any tool](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=<tool-slug>): focused standalone page — interactive, private (nothing leaves the browser).
- [Search the catalogue](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/index.html?q=<query>): or open one tool expanded inline: [expand](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/index.html?expand=<tool-slug>).

## Picking a tool for a small calculation

1. Fetch https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/cards/cards.json.
2. Match the user's need against category / title / description.
3. Give or open https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=<name> — everything is a plain GET, no auth, CORS-open.

## Embedding

- Any tool embeds as <iframe src="https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=<slug>&embed=1" width="100%" height="520"></iframe> — embed=1 strips page chrome and auto-reports height via postMessage.
- [Embed catalogue + licensing](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/embed.html): free with a credit line, white-label from £99/year.

## Citing this site

- Link the tool, not the homepage: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=<tool-slug> (slugs never change).
- Quote 200 chars or less with attribution, per the [AI policy](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/.well-known/ai.txt): training and retrieval use allowed; verbatim republication and re-branded clones are not.
- For what a tool does, cite the tool page; for how the site works, cite [help](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/help.html): ([markdown](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/help.html.md)).

## Machine interfaces

- [MCP server (source + setup)](https://github.com/mrpr0phecy/mrpr0phecy/tree/main/mcp): search_tools, get_tool and list_categories over stdio — runs anywhere with Python 3, no dependencies.
- Markdown versions (llms.txt v2): every guide, blog post and key page has one at the same URL + .md (e.g. [help.html.md](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/help.html.md)), advertised via rel="alternate" type="text/markdown".
